dedupe_keys.name: automated extraction of forest road network geometry from aerial lidar

description: Automated Extraction of Forest Road Network Geometry from Aerial LiDAR is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Storm, J. C. (deposited on HydroShare). We developed an algorithm that was designed to create a spatial database of a forested transportation network using aerial LiDAR. The algorithm uses two main attributes, LiDAR intensity values and ground return density. The road extraction process was developed using aerial LiDAR from McDonald-Dunn Research Forest near Corvallis, Oregon, U.S.A. Coverage: Oregon, United States. The resource was created 2018-04-01 and last updated 2018-04-09; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
